taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-04
Curve type: QHK-type curve (Q: 133.9→50.7→23.0; H: 50.7→23.0→61.9; K: 23.0→61.9→20.8)
Aquifer depth: 47.47 m to depth of investigation (basal layer, ρ = 20.8 Ω·m, unconfined base)

Recommendation: Target the thick, low-resistivity layer beginning at 47.47 m as the primary aquifer zone; drill through the overlying resistive layer (43.15–47.47 m, 61.9 Ω·m) and set screen/casing to isolate this basal conductive unit, confirming lithology and water strike with cuttings/geophysical logging as drilling proceeds.
